arguments.content: Pattern: prematurely removing legacy read compatibility during a bounded migration. A writer already emitting the new shape and passing new-write tests do not establish that a reader can contract its accepted data shapes. If unchanged list consumers abort on a single unreadable row, removing the legacy fallback turns partially migrated data into whole-list unavailability. Verify actual supported fixtures before migration, after a bounded batch that leaves legacy rows, after completion, and after an idempotent retry, asserting preserved values. Keep fallback removal gated on the supported-data contract permitting it. Observed in isolated destination-reader review: P1 introduced read availability regression; actual baseline succeeded throughout, candidate failed initial and intermediate states while both existing nested/empty tests passed.
